meta.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, TradeStat (DGCI&S customs data)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each month is printed final (F) in its own month's table and revised final (R) in the table a year later; principal-commodity quick estimates are provisional (P). Every value carries its flag in meta.revision.
meta.coverage: India's exports to, imports from and trade balance with every partner, every financial year since 2009-10, US$ million (the long partner history)
meta.note: TradeStat FTSPCC total-trade table, read only from its March tables (whole financial years); each year is the revised column of the following March's table where it exists. A different publication from the monthly partner tables (2017 on): shown beside them, never joined. Balance as printed.
